description:
Build the "Panorama" dashboard — the aggregate "state of the world" view. This is THE page you leave up on the TV.

**Theme: Cosmos**
Deep black with subtle animated nebula gradient (purple/blue). Each metric domain represented as a planet/celestial body sized proportionally to importance. Sparklines as orbital paths. Central "sun" represents overall system health — brightness/color reflects composite state. Planets orbit at distances proportional to how much attention each area needs (troubled areas orbit closer). Slow, meditative animation. Calming yet informative.

**Content — curated best-of from each domain:**
- From Mission Control: system health (scenarios running/total), items completed this week
- From The Hive: scenario count with running/stopped ratio, average completeness score
- From The Forge: velocity this week, estimated weeks remaining, backlog size
- From Ledger: subscriber count (or MRR when available), churn indicator
- From Broadcast: visitor count (last 7d), conversion rate

**Gap metrics:**
- "System pulse" — animated heartbeat that speeds up with overall activity level
- Alert/anomaly indicators (churn spike, blocked ratio threshold, scenario down) — planets flash or change color
- Per-domain 30-day trend sparklines

**Layout concept:** Solar system visualization in center. Sun = system health. Five planets orbiting = one per dashboard domain. Each planet shows its hero metric. Orbital distance = attention needed (closer = more urgent). Clicking/focusing a planet navigates to that dashboard. Ambient star field with occasional shooting stars when milestones hit (new subscriber, item completed, scenario deployed).

**Depends on all other pages** because its data payload is a curated subset of the other five — should reuse same API structures and metric definitions.
name: command-center-panorama-page
title: Build Panorama dashboard — aggregate overview with Cosmos theme
